## History

Phillips served as the schoolmaster in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), having originally secured the position because his uncle was a school trustee, and he boarded at Eben Wright's house. Known for maintaining poor order in his classroom while frequently whipping his pupils, he publicly humiliated [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on her first day back by forcing her to stand at the blackboard and later making her sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for her tardiness. Following these incidents, Phillips eventually departed from his role as the village schoolmaster.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P6](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as [Prissy](../character/prissy-andrews.md) Andrews' schoolmaster and mentor. Their connection remains central to the schoolroom dynamic during his time teaching in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He eventually departs the school, leaving his role as her instructor behind.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

As Anne's former schoolmaster, Mr. Phillips frequently singled her out for public humiliation and strict punishment. After she smashed a slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head, he forced her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) when she arrived late, prompting a deeply outraged [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to temporarily leave school rather than submit to his discipline. She eventually returned to her studies at home, effectively ending his mentorship over her.

- Mentor of — former pupil (since v2)  <sub>[v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
